title: RiskState
description: Standard schema for multimodal risk classification emitted by backend risk engine.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the fused risk assessment.

risk_score.description: Normalized composite risk score on a scale from 0.0 to 100.0.

contributing_reasons.description: List of human-readable rationale items explaining why the state was evaluated (e.g. 'Prolonged eye closure (2.1s)', 'Abnormal heart rate (48 bpm)').

monitoring_reliable.description: True if sufficient input telemetry was available and reliable to form a valid risk assessment.

vision_snapshot.description: Optional snapshot of the vision event that triggered or fed this state.

sensor_snapshot.description: Optional snapshot of the sensor reading that triggered or fed this state.
